metadata.target_audience: Software Engineers, Tech Leads, CTOs, & Product Ops Teams in India using Indian Payment/Logistics/SMS APIs
metadata.theme_archetype: Dark-mode-first with Terminal Amber Highlights (Awwwards/Linear/Vercel Quality)
design_principles: Tactical Terminal Precision: High contrast, dark void background (#08090E) with intense alert-amber (#F59E0B) focus.
Zero AI-Slop / Anti-Pattern: NO Inter, NO Space Grotesk, NO fake user counts, NO fake testimonials, NO generic hero layouts.
Content as Truth: Real Indian API horror stories (Razorpay silent webhook drops, Shiprocket unannounced tier limits, Cashfree parameter breaks, RBI ₹15,000 mandate failures).
Single Dominant Action: Email waitlist capture is the sole focal point, frictionless and uninhibited by competing CTAs.
Kinetic & Purposeful Motion: Masked line-by-line typography reveals, slow editorial marquee, smooth Lenis inertia scrolling, and live pulse telemetry cards.

content.headline: Your Razorpay integration just broke. You'll find out in 3 hours. We'll tell you in 30 seconds.
content.subheadline: Real-time monitoring engine specifically built for Indian API stack — Razorpay, PhonePe, Cashfree, Shiprocket, Delhivery, MSG91 & Gupshup. Catch silent webhook drops, SDK error masking, and undocumented tier limits before revenue bleeds.

primary_cta.helper_text: Built by developers who got burned by silent API failures too.

3_the_problem.headline: Indian APIs don't warn you before they break you
3_the_problem.subheadline: Global monitoring tools (Datadog, Sentry, New Relic) check HTTP 500 status codes. They don't know that Razorpay returns 200 OK with an error body, or that Shiprocket silently marks addresses as non-deliverable.

columns.title: Silent Webhook Failures
columns.description: Webhooks fail signature verification silently or fail to retry after temporary server blips. Your database never updates, orders remain pending, and users get charged without fulfillment.

columns.title: Undocumented Tier Restrictions
columns.description: Logistics APIs suddenly return 'deliverable: false' for valid pin codes without any HTTP error code or documentation when account rate limits or undisclosed tier rules kick in.

columns.title: SDK Breaking Changes & RBI Mandates
columns.description: Minor SDK upgrades swallow error objects or break on parameter format tweaks. RBI e-mandate rules cap recurring charges over ₹15,000 without sending structured failure webhooks.

founder_note.title: A Note From The Founder
founder_note.author: Aniket S. (20-year-old Operations Analyst & Systems Builder, Bengaluru)
founder_note.body: Three months ago, a silent Razorpay webhook error dropped ₹2.4 Lakhs worth of orders on a Friday night. Our team found out 14 hours later when angry customers flooded Twitter. When I dug into GitHub issues, Reddit r/developersIndia, and Indian tech Slack groups, I found hundreds of devs suffering from the exact same silent drops on Cashfree, Shiprocket, and MSG91. Global tools like Datadog don't care about DLT SMS templates or RBI auto-debit caps over ₹15,000. That's why I'm building Sentinel. Honest, deep, India-native API telemetry so you never lose revenue to an undocumented break again.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scrolling: Lenis library initialization with dampening factor 0.1, smoothWheel true

component_specs.ProviderPill: Monospace text badge with subtle dot indicator. Active amber hover glow and tooltip describing specific monitored Indian API failure cases.
component_specs.LiveAlertCard: Dark terminal frame with window controls (red/yellow/green dots), pulse header 'LIVE_MUMBAI_TELEMETRY', scrollable alert items with severity tag, payload diff accordion.
component_specs.WaitlistForm: High-contrast form wrapper with glowing border on focus, client-side email regex validation, instant simulated submission feedback displaying batch queue position (e.g. 'You are #142 in Batch 3 access queue'), and backend POST integration to `/api/waitlist`.
component_specs.FounderNote: Styled quotation card with amber left border accent, handwritten style signature tag, and verified builder badge.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: High contrast APCA verified (Text #F9FAFB on #08090E canvas ratio > 14:1, Amber #F59E0B on dark surface ratio > 7:1)
accessibility_and_testing.interactive_states: All buttons & input fields must explicitly set text color on focus/hover (e.g. hover:text-amber-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: Every interactive and section container MUST contain explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format as outlined in section_by_section_blueprints.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute phase-by-phase implementation strictly using React JS (.js files).
Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion lenis @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react canvas-confetti sonner
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis in App.js or main entry point.
Load Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'DM Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' in index.html or index.css.
Build backend FastAPI endpoint `/api/waitlist` to accept POST requests `{ email: string }` and persist to a simple JSON/SQLite store.
Ensure Waitlist email capture works in both Hero section and Waitlist section seamlessly.
Do NOT include fake testimonials, fake user numbers, or generic stock photos. Keep it purely code/telemetry aesthetic.
Include live interactive mock alert card in the Hero section with dynamic alert updates every few seconds.
Verify all `data-testid` attributes match the specified blueprint keys.
